title: 港股午后跌势加剧，恒生科技指数跌超3%
summary: 7月22日午后港股全线走弱，恒生科技指数跌幅扩大至超3%，互联网、半导体等科技权重股集体承压。
why: 持有腾讯、阿里、美团等港股科技仓位，跌超3%加大账面浮亏压力，亦可能提升短腿Sell Put被行权风险。

title: Oil prices jump 4% as Rubio says Iran not serious about peace talks
summary: Brent crude spiked to ~$94.20 on Wednesday as Sec. of State Rubio signaled Iran is not serious about negotiations, following the 11th consecutive night of US strikes on Iran. Kuwait air defenses intercepted Iranian drones. Oil settled at a five-week high the prior session.
why: 油价飙涨推高通胀预期，叠加FOMC 7月28-29日会议前夕，市场对加息概率预期上升，整体压制风险资产估值，对科技股持仓不利。

title: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide as oil rises; Alphabet and Tesla earnings on deck tonight
summary: US equity futures slipped Wednesday morning as Brent crude surged above $92, raising inflation concerns. S&P 500 had closed at 7,509 Tuesday (+0.89%). Alphabet (GOOGL) and Tesla (TSLA) report Q2 results after the bell, marking the start of Big Tech earnings season.
why: 大科技财报周开幕，两家核心持仓或关注标的今晚同时公布业绩，结果将直接影响科技板块情绪与期权隐含波动率。

title: 证监会两日连开座谈会增强市场稳定性；A股ETF连续11日净流入累计3567亿元
summary: 证监会党委班子7月20-21日连开座谈会，29位代表参与，表态持续加强资本市场基础制度建设。截至7月20日，全市场股票ETF已连续11个交易日净流入，区间累计3567亿元。
why: 证监会明确稳市信号，叠加ETF大额流入，A股短期下行空间或受限，有利于持有A股仓位的长期持有策略。

title: FOMC July 28-29 meeting: CPI hits 4.2%, market pricing 25-46% chance of rate hike
summary: The upcoming July 28-29 FOMC meeting faces a challenging backdrop: CPI rose to 4.2% YoY in mid-July, its highest since April 2023, fueled by oil prices and Middle East supply risks. Fed funds rate is at 3.5-3.75%. Market-implied probability of a 25bp hike at the meeting has risen to 25-46%.
why: FOMC若意外加息或鹰派措辞，将压制高估值科技股，拉升期权隐含波动率，影响Sell Put策略的风险收益比，需密切关注。

title: 科创板开市七周年：611家硬科技企业，AI与半导体领跑
summary: 2026年7月22日，科创板迎来开市七周年。自首批25家企业上市至今，已有611家企业组成硬科技军团，涵盖集成电路、AI、生物医药等核心赛道。
why: 科创板持续扩容，为A股半导体与AI赛道定价提供参考锚点，也带来新的标的关注机会。

title: 证监会主席吴清会见加拿大养老基金投资公司CEO，释放外资开放信号
summary: 7月22日，证监会主席吴清在北京会见加拿大养老基金投资公司（CPPIB）总裁兼首席执行官格雷厄姆，就深化资本市场合作交换意见。
why: 外资养老金巨头持续与证监会高层互动，表明机构长期看好A股，对市场情绪形成正向支撑。

title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Q2 2026 Earnings Tonight: Consensus EPS $2.89, Revenue $116.8B; Google Cloud 63-65% Growth in Focus
summary: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 results after market close Wednesday. Analyst consensus: EPS $2.89 on revenue $116.84B (41 analysts). Google Cloud expected to sustain ~63-65% YoY growth. Alphabet guided ~$190B in AI capex for 2026, putting pressure on margins. Earnings call at 1:30pm PT.
why: 谷歌云增速是AI基础设施变现的风向标，若高于预期将提振整体科技板块情绪，间接利好持有腾讯/阿里云等中国科技云业务标的。

title: Intel (INTC) Surges ~8% on Tuesday: 18A Yield at 85%, Fortinet Joins as First Cybersecurity Foundry Customer
summary: Intel stock closed up ~8% to $105.45 on Tuesday as three catalysts converged: 18A process yield reportedly rose to ~85% (nearing TSMC's 90% benchmark), Fortinet became the first cybersecurity firm to place foundry orders, and Google confirmed Xeon chip use. Q2 earnings are due Thursday July 23. Intel is up over 160% YTD.
why: 英特尔18A代工进展提速，可能重塑半导体代工竞争格局，对英伟达GPU供应链和AI芯片赛道有关联影响；明日Q2业绩将是年内最重要催化剂。

title: SK Hynix Rockets ~14% Ahead of July 29 Earnings: Q2 Profit Seen +556% YoY; HBM4 Mass Production Starting Q3
summary: SK Hynix shares surged ~14% to $172.80 as investors positioned ahead of July 29 earnings. Analyst KIS projects Q2 operating profit at ~60.4T won (+556% YoY), but ~8% below 65T won consensus, as HBM4 mass production slipped to Q3 2026. HBM4 demand is fully booked through 2027.
why: SK海力士是HBM内存链条核心，也影响南方两倍做多工具；Q2业绩将检验HBM定价走势和HBM4量产节奏，对英伟达Blackwell/Rubin平台供货意义重大。

title: Tesla Expands Robotaxi Service to Orlando and Tampa Ahead of Q2 Earnings
summary: Tesla announced July 21 the expansion of its autonomous ride-hailing service to Orlando and Tampa, adding to Austin, Dallas, Houston and Miami. The service operates in Florida, California and Texas. CEO Musk noted meaningful revenue contribution not expected until next year.
why: Robotaxi里程碑是Tesla长期估值叙事的核心支撑，今晚Q2业绩电话会预计Musk将更新Optimus与自动驾驶进展，需关注对TSLA期权定价的影响。

title: 小米汽车7月单月交付超3万辆创新高，YU7 SUV等待周期拉至59周
summary: 小米汽车7月单月交付超3万辆，创月度纪录新高，YU7 SUV为主要驱动力。受产能瓶颈制约，YU7新订单预计交付周期已延伸至59周（约2027年下半年），全年55万辆目标仍存压力。
why: 汽车交付高景气印证小米1810.HK基本面改善；但产能瓶颈制约短期上行。YU7等待名单长度是跟踪需求热度的关键指标，同时影响小米整体IoT生态协同预期。
